source_note: an epsilon of room证明集合为0测度的策略
english_source_note: An Epsilon of Room for Measure Zero Sets
callout_id: an epsilon of room证明集合为0测度的策略#5
statement_en: Prove that on a $\sigma$-finite measure space $(\Omega,\mathcal{F},\mu)$, if $f$ is a nonnegative measurable function and $\int_E f\,d\mu=0$ for a measurable set $E$ with positive measure, then $f=0$ almost everywhere on $E$.
key_techniques: distribution function or superlevel set argument
positivity of the integral of a nonnegative function
callout_body: 证明在sigma-finite的测度空间$(\Omega,\mathcal{F},\mu)$上，**对于非负可测函数$f$，在一个测度为正的集合$E$上的积分$\int_{E}f\,d\mu =0$那么$f =0$在集合$E$上几乎处处成立。**
